checked_source: NY Fed ACM Treasury Term Premia data / Liberty Street Economics ACM explainer
key_observation: ACM decomposes Treasury yields into expected future short rates plus term premium; public weekly data include term premia and expected average short rates for annual maturities 1-10y.
mapped_to_band: Supports using TP as the residual object and limits direct official-tenor evidence to <=10y; 30y extrapolated.

checked_source: Board/FRED Kim-Wright three-factor arbitrage-free term premium series
key_observation: KW provides an alternative no-arbitrage three-factor term premium estimate for the 10y zero-coupon bond.
mapped_to_band: Used as model-diversity check against ACM/CR decompositions in the 2023 episode.

checked_source: Diercks, Federal Reserve FEDS Notes, The Treasury Tantrum of 2023
key_observation: From 2023-07-26 to 2023-10-19, estimated 10y TP rose +64 to +116bp across ACM/CR/KW/regression/Blue-Chip methods while the 2y yield rose about +30bp and the 10y yield rose over 100bp; much unwound by year-end.
mapped_to_band: Not a pure stance elasticity; supports positive 10y/long-end high tail for persistent/HFL plus supply/QT states and positive QT interaction.

checked_source: Gürkaynak, Sack and Swanson, FEDS 2004/2005 target/path factors
key_observation: A 1pp target surprise moves 2y/5y/10y yields about +47/+27/+12bp; a 1pp path innovation moves 5y/10y about +36/+27bp; path factor explains much more long-yield variation than target factor.
mapped_to_band: 2y transient mostly expectations; 10y transient base requires small TP residual after one-year path persistence; supports split between target/path and pure level expectations.

source_family: FOMC high-frequency event study with FG/LSAP split
checked_source: Swanson 2021 JME, Measuring effects of forward guidance and asset purchases
key_observation: Forward-guidance effects peak around one year and decline at longer maturities; LSAP/supply factor has larger long-end effects; several-month half-life point estimates for FG attenuation are not statistically significant.
mapped_to_band: Supports 9-15m effective market-perceived policy-path persistence in validation and larger long-end residuals when balance-sheet/supply channel is active.

source_family: Term-premium event study / forward real rates
checked_source: Hanson and Stein, Monetary Policy and Long-Term Real Rates
key_observation: A 100bp increase in 2y nominal yield on FOMC days is associated with roughly +42bp in distant 10y-forward real rates; authors interpret much of this as term premium and note reversal over subsequent months.
mapped_to_band: Supports positive same-direction TP channel for transient shocks, but event-day forward-rate responses are not annual average yield scalars.

checked_source: Hanson, Lucca and Wright, NY Fed Staff Report 810
key_observation: Since 2000, a 100bp monthly rise in 1y yields is associated with +66bp in 10y yields; about 36bp is expected to reverse over the next six months, interpreted as a temporary term-premium component.
mapped_to_band: Sets high-side transient tail but argues against applying high-frequency peak response as persistent static input.

source_family: Forward guidance, uncertainty and ACM term premium
checked_source: Bundick, Herriford and Smith, Kansas City Fed RWP 17-07
key_observation: Pure first-moment target/path factors are not robust term-premium drivers across maturities; rate-uncertainty factors remain significant. August 2011 FG lowered 10y ACM/KW term premia by >15bp.
mapped_to_band: Keeps pure deterministic persistent-level low at 0 and attributes positive TP mainly to uncertainty/supply/risk-premium channel.

checked_source: Du, Forbes and Luzzetti, Quantitative Tightening Around the Globe
key_observation: QT announcements raise government bond yields and steepen curves; active-QT effects are larger at long maturities, with about +8bp 10y and +6bp 30y active-QT announcement effects after controls, while term-premium coefficients are positive but often insignificant.
mapped_to_band: Conditional QT/supply add-on: 10y 0/5/10bp; 30y 2/8/15bp; no default 2y adjustment.

checked_source: Neely, St. Louis Fed WP, How Persistent Are Unconventional Monetary Policy Effects?
key_observation: Wright-style VAR point estimates imply 3-6m half-lives for 10y yield responses, but the paper argues persistence is hard to estimate and constrained models imply more persistent responses; one cannot reject >1y half-life.
mapped_to_band: Validation reports 3-6m half-life as a failure-to-close case for policy-path betas, and uses ~12m base as project-consistent market-perceived path persistence.
